newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci first quarter sales up 31.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gucci first quarter sales up 31.5 pct.

text.p: Italian luxury goods company Gucci Group NV, said on Thursday sales in its first quarter to April 30 rose 31.5 pct to $254.3 million.
Gucci is listed on the Amsterdam and New York Stock exchanges.
Gucci's chief executive Domenico De Sole said in a statement that the sales performance had exceeded the company's expectations.
"We are pleased to note that we achieved these results despite weakness in the yen, which negatively impacted Japanese tourism and spending, especially during April," he said.
Gucci saw a substantial decline in Japanese travel and luxury goods spending during the Golden Week holiday, which occurs at the end of April every year.
De Sole said the company's programme of store openings and refurbishments was on track as Gucci continued to expand its base of directly operated stores.
"We opened four new Gucci boutiques during the quarter in Shanghai, Beijing and Causeway Bay in Hong Kong, as well as Osaka, our first freestanding store in Japan," De Sole said.
He added Gucci was continuing to improve its store base through a refurbishment and expansion programme.
